title: Fleet routing policy v1 (contract 2.0.0)
description: flow's routing policy at <dorkHome>/flow/fleet.json (spec flow-cli-core 1.1b). Writers store only what the operator set; defaults are resolved at read time. Readers ignore fields they do not know; writers keep them. This is the WRITER shape. Readers accept more: a file with no v reads as version 1, and a bare account key written before contract 2.0.0 reads as claude-code:<key>; writers never write either. A file with another v is not read (every account at its default) and never written.

runtimes.description: Runtimes in order of preference. Default [] (the runtime the item started on first).

accounts.description: Keyed <runtime>:<account-id>: an id in that runtime's registry in config.json, or default for its implicit account.

role.description: Default rotation for an implicit default account, else kept-out.

repos.description: owner/name, compared case-insensitively. Read only for kept-out. Default [].
